Our Mission

A giving movement,
not another speculative token.

What started as a simple desire to give from the heart has grown into a complete movement. Every trade of $G2G turns everyday action into real help for kids fighting cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

Most cryptocurrencies exist only to chase price charts, and most charity coins deliver one-time donations with little transparency. Grind2Give is built differently: the giving is automatic, transparent, and perpetual — coded into the contract itself, so it happens on every buy whether anyone is watching or not.

The recipient hospital treats children at no cost to families — research, treatment, and care, so no family ever receives a bill. Your grind helps fund that work.

“Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.”

Matthew 25:40 — the verse behind Grind2Give

More Than a Coin Hunter

Meet Sentinel Grind.

Sentinel Grind is Grind2Give's Telegram bot (@Grind2GiveBot) — and hunting coins is only one of his jobs. Yes, he scans Base, Ethereum, BSC, and Solana around the clock for brand-new tokens, and every coin he signals has to pass a strict safety gate first. But he's also the AI host who talks with the community in character, the shield that filters spam and scams, and the engine behind grind points, leaderboards, giveaways, referrals, and streaks. The split is simple: the coin hunting and signals belong to Grind2Give alone — everything else he does is built to be rented by other groups.

He's always evolving.

Sentinel Grind never stands still. He's always growing, learning, and leveling up — adding new features, sharper safety checks, and new ways to serve the community. What he can do today is just the start: as Grind2Give grows, so does he.

Questions

Straight answers.

How does the charity money actually move?

Every buy pays a 10% tax: 8% earmarked for charity, 1.5% for holder dividends, 0.5% burned. The taxes accumulate inside the contract until they reach 0.5% of the liquidity pool's token balance — then the contract automatically swaps and sends the charity share to the public charity wallet, pays dividends, and burns. It's all on-chain and verifiable on Basescan.

Is the hospital affiliated with Grind2Give?

No. The decision to support a leading pediatric cancer research hospital was made solely by the Grind2Give project. The hospital is not affiliated with, does not endorse, and has no involvement in the $G2G token or this project. We direct the proceeds to their work because of the impact they're already making — children treated there are never billed.

Can the contract be changed later?

No. Contract ownership has been fully renounced — taxes, limits, and every owner function are locked permanently. Nobody, including the creator, can change the rules, mint more tokens, or pause trading.

How do holder dividends work?

Hold at least 2,540 $G2G in your wallet and you're eligible. When the tax threshold fires, your share of the 1.5% is distributed automatically — no claiming, no staking, nothing to sign up for.

What is Sentinel Grind, and can I rent it?

Sentinel Grind is Grind2Give's Telegram bot — much more than a coin hunter, and he's always evolving: always growing, learning, and adding new features and new ways to serve the community. The coin hunting and signals (multi-chain, with a strict safety gate) are exclusive to Grind2Give and are not for rent. Everything else he does is rentable for other groups: AI chat that talks with your community in character, spam and scam filtering, grind points and leaderboards, giveaways, referrals and streaks, and the full command set. Rentals are coming soon and are not open yet. Follow @Grind2GiveBot for the announcement.

Is this financial advice?

No. Nothing on this page is financial advice. Crypto is extremely volatile — do your own research, never spend what you can't afford to lose, and never share your seed phrase or private key with anyone.
